newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis reiterates France to sell Thomson.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis reiterates France to sell Thomson.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis reiterated on Wednesday the centre-right government's intention to privatise electronics group Thomson SA and said it would work out the details in the coming weeks.
"There is no question of abandoning the privatisation of Thomson," Arthuis told the national assembly. "We will define the details of the privatisation...we will no doubt take several weeks."
He said that the privatisation process had been carried out in total "transparency".
The government announced earlier on Wednesday it was calling off the sale of Thomson to Lagardere Groupe after the independent privatisation commission expressed objections.
Arthuis said that the privatisation commission believed that the sale of Thomson to Lagardere made sense on defence grounds.
But he said the commission had been worried about the technology transfer aspects of Lagardere's plans to sell Thomson's consumer electronics arm, Thomson Multimedia, unit to Daewoo Electronics.
